description: This script automates the process of identifying new lines in code coverage data between two versions in a git repository, correlating uncovered lines with blame information, and summarizing changes that introduce uncovered code. It combines git diff, gcov coverage reports, and blame annotations to produce a report of untested new code introduced between specified versions.
external_files: git (repository data including diff, blame, and log)
shell utilities (sed, grep, sort, comm, etc.)

methods.name: diff_lines
methods.description: Processes diff output to extract line numbers of added lines from diff hunks using Perl.
